id: 311
status: Fixed
summary: Reproduceable crash with switch statement
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-High']
stars: 1
commentCount: 3
Comment 0 (2011-01-06): When attempting to compile the following code with default options (-jar compiler.jar --js filename) always produces the same error. function a(b) { switch (b.v) { case 'SWITCH': if (b.i >= 0) { return b.o; } else { return undefined; } break; } } Whenever I try and compile the above script I get a RuntimeException thrown: INTERNAL COMPILER ERROR. Please report this problem. null Node(BREAK): C:\test.js:11:3 break; Parent: NULL The result of calling --version on compiler.jar: Version: 20100917 (revision 440) Built on: 2010/09/17 17:55 The result of calling -version on java.exe: java version "1.6.0_11" Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 1.6.0_11-b03) Java HotSpot(TM) Client VM (build 11.0-b16, mixed mode, sharing) Anyone else with the same issue - to work around in the short term, comment out the "break;" line.
Comment 1 (2011-01-06): Thanks for the report
Comment 2 (2011-01-08): This issue was closed by revision r676.
